package: WP-J / WP-U9: B3-H3 L1 attempt 4 (aux-trained bridge, fresh data) - confirmatory test of the 2026-10-20 fix candidate
gate: G-CALLOSUM-UTILITY-002 via unchanged b3bridge.l1_gate (BYTES_W .25, BYTES_NORM 4000, paired mean-2se>0, role_drop<=.01, ood<=.05, reload identical)
motivation: bench-results/b3-l1-diagnose-20261020/README.md: attempt-3 FAIL is a training-signal problem; Bridge(aux=2) passed exploratorily on action only, on seen test items

data.templates: identical to attempt 3 (V3.make), only the sampling seed changes

states: NEW B1/B2 states computed from the fresh rows (no reuse of attempt-3 states.npz)

bridge_config.epochs: 6 blocks x 10, best on select split
bridge_config.aux: 2 training-only targets: sender-side U=sum(urgency), F=sum(frustration), standardized on the fit split; used in every block; Wa never reaches receive()

channels: LATENT = aux bridge (gate input). LATENT_NOAUX = attempt-3 bridge recipe, reference only. All baselines/controls as attempt 3.
runner_check_before_run: 6 attempt-3 rows recomputed: receiver pooled states bit-identical to attempt-3 cache; sender token states rel. L2 diff 0.0089 (fp16-level CPU/batch numerics), masks identical

tasks.action: call if U>=8 and F>=8, fix_quietly if U>=8, else schedule

verdict_rule: Per task/view l1_gate twice: SYMBOLIC=label word and SYMBOLIC=attribute level words; canon L1 PASS only if both PASS. strict_scalar reported separately; a strict FAIL is a claim limit. Target = private view. Single run; no re-run with changed settings counts as this attempt; FAIL stays FAIL.
expectation_from_exploration: PASS likely on action; escalate/apologize likely FAIL against attribute words
consequence_if_pass: L2 prefix SHADOW experiment allowed for passing task(s) only; LATENT authority stays 0; frozen runtime unchanged
consequence_if_fail: B3_LATENT stays unavailable, L2 locked; record negative result
hardware: Linux x86_64 cloud CPU, 4 threads; not Redmi
